<div class="card-body">
'''Wookiee Roar''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ウーキーの雄叫び</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">いずれか1つを選ぶ。1：チューバッカが特定の位置カードで単独で戦闘を防衛している時に使う。戦闘運命数を2回加えることができる。2：3フォース消費して自分のリザーブ・デッキの中から「チューバッカ」を探して手札に入れる。その後デッキをシャッフルし、カットして元の場所に置く。3：場に出ている“マウス”ドロイドを1体脅かす（ロストさせる）。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Wookiee-Roar-PSA-89673882.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">チューバッカの雄叫びに一喝されれば、マウス・ドロイドさえ一目散にその場を立ち去る。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Wookiee Roar.

'''Card text:'''
Choose one.

1: Use when Chewbacca is defending a battle alone at a specific location card. You may add two battle destiny.

2: Use 3 Force to search your Reserve Deck for Chewbacca and take it into hand. Then shuffle the deck, cut, and replace.

3: Threaten (lose) one "mouse" droid on table.

'''Lore:'''
If Chewbacca's roar rebukes them, even a mouse droid flees that spot at once.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese lore describes Chewbacca's roar scattering a mouse droid; English lore is only the roar onomatopoeia.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Wookiee Roar]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
